name: Starry Multi-Aim
effects:
Grants [Master Mode], [Instant ATB 1] & [Diffusion Barrier 1] to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE, Ice/NE, Lightning/NE or Poisom/NE ranged physical attacks + minor DeProtect for 5 seconds, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/Poison/NE piercing ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 + DeProtect 30% for 5 seconds, Instant Cast 1 to user, removes Master Mode
